en_us: Admin screen: each settlement of the list shows its faction (color and name), its culture and its population. A button "Filters" opens filters for the faction, the culture, the level and the population.
fr_fr: Écran d'administration : chaque colonie de la liste montre sa faction (couleur et nom), sa culture et sa population. Un bouton « Filtres » ouvre des filtres pour la faction, la culture, le niveau et la population.
